# Backtest: pre-match surface Elo

Chronological replay of 196,560 tour-level singles matches (TML-Database, 1968 onward). Each match is predicted from ratings that have absorbed only earlier matches, then it updates them. Model choices were made on **2014–2018** (validation) and scored once on **2019–2026** (test).

Excluded from both rating updates and scoring: walkovers, defaults, unknown results, and every row whose player identity failed a check (ID/name conflict, unknown or missing ID, placeholder player).

## Test window, headline

| Model | n | Accuracy | Brier | Log loss | ECE |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Coin flip | 19,021 | 50.0% | 0.2500 | 0.6931 | 0.0003 |
| Ranking logistic (β=0.651, fitted on validation) | 19,021 | 63.9% | 0.2203 | 0.6301 | 0.0256 |
| Elo, overall only | 19,021 | 64.1% | 0.2233 | 0.6410 | 0.0614 |
| Elo, 50/50 surface blend (FiveThirtyEight-style) | 19,021 | 64.2% | 0.2213 | 0.6339 | 0.0537 |
| **Elo, selected on validation** | 19,021 | 64.3% | 0.2179 | 0.6241 | 0.0264 |

Lower is better for Brier, log loss and ECE (expected calibration error, 10 bins). Market baseline: not run: Kalshi and Polymarket hosts are blocked by this environment's network policy.

Selected model, completed matches only (retirements removed): Brier 0.2165, log loss 0.6208, n = 18,522.

## How the model was chosen

Greedy forward selection: start from the FiveThirtyEight-style blend, try each single change, adopt the one that most improves **validation** log loss, repeat until nothing improves. Test numbers are shown for transparency only; they played no part in the choice.

| Step | Validation log loss | Test log loss | Test Brier | Test ECE |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline (FiveThirtyEight-style blend) | 0.60100 | 0.63394 | 0.22125 | 0.0537 |
| + prediction scale x1.3 | 0.59606 | 0.62485 | 0.21823 | 0.0184 |
| + best-of-5 adjustment | 0.59463 | 0.62464 | 0.21819 | 0.0245 |
| + merge indoor hard into hard | 0.59435 | 0.62413 | 0.21788 | 0.0264 |

Selected configuration: `surface_weight=0.5`, `split_indoor_hard=False`, `new_player_prior=flat`, `surface_init=flat`, `bo5_adjust=True`, `pred_scale=1.3`, `k_num=250.0`, `k_offset=5.0`, `k_shape=0.4`.
